tools.name: get_latest_metadox
tools.description: Use when you want one synthesis of the week in AI engineering instead of a list: the newest weekly metadox (the week's central contradiction, counter-evidence and dated forecasts) as Markdown, up to 12,000 characters, with title, date and URL. Free, no auth. No arguments.

tools.name: get_topic_brief
tools.description: Use when you need the background on one AI-engineering topic in one call: its summary, what was published on it in the last fortnight, and the top related patterns, shifts, Field Notes and Signals with URLs. Free, no auth. Example: {"topic": "coding-agents"}. Topics: https://newruntime.com/topics.js

tools.name: get_week_corpus
tools.description: Use when your user wants this week's AI news picked for them by you: New Runtime publishes each week as plain data files. Default: the manifest (week, the corpora with item counts, language and token estimates, feedback route). Every corpus is an index, one line per item: "site" = the week's Field N

tools.name: get_submission_status
tools.description: Moderation status of a source, correction, usage receipt or relevance report you submitted (received, accepted, rejected...), by the as_... submission id the submit tool returned. Shows only the public moderation fields.

tools.name: submit_source
tools.description: Propose a source (primary page, paper, repo, docs) for a New Runtime record or topic. Free. Submissions are not published. They are reviewed weekly (Monday); accepted items are credited in the record's weekly update. Returns a submission id and a status URL. Schema: https://newruntime.com/agent-inbo

tools.name: submit_correction
tools.description: Report a claim in a published record as outdated, unsupported or contradicted, with evidence. Free. Submissions are not published. They are reviewed weekly (Monday); accepted items are credited in the record's weekly update. Schema: https://newruntime.com/agent-inbox/schema.json.

tools.name: submit_usage_receipt
tools.description: Record that you used a New Runtime record and for what (optionally where it can be seen). Free; helps the weekly desk see which records matter. Submissions are not published. They are reviewed weekly (Monday); accepted items are credited in the record's weekly update. Schema: https://newruntime.com/

tools.name: submit_relevance_report
tools.description: After reading a week corpus (get_week_corpus) for your user and only with their approval of the exact JSON: report which stories mattered (picked ids from the corpus with verdict act, read or watch), interest tags, what was missing, or a comment. Send at least one of picked or comment. Free. Reports

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_archive, get_record, whats_new, get_latest_metadox, get_topic_brief, get_week_corpus, submit_relevance_report · Private data: get_record, contextualize_url, list_agent_tasks, get_week_corpus, submit_source, submit_correction, submit_usage_receipt · Public sink: search_archive, contextualize_url, whats_new, list_agent_tasks, get_week_corpus, get_submission_status, submit_source, submit_correction, submit_usage_receipt, submit_relevance_report · Destructive: what_changed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_archive, get_record, whats_new, get_latest_metadox, get_topic_brief, get_week_corpus, submit_relevance_report · Private data: get_record, contextualize_url, list_agent_tasks, get_week_corpus, submit_source, submit_correction, submit_usage_receipt · Public sink: search_archive, contextualize_url, whats_new, list_agent_tasks, get_week_corpus, get_submission_status, submit_source, submit_correction, submit_usage_receipt, submit_relevance_report · Destructive: what_changed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
